narrative.northStar: Taiwan Topographic Field Guide & Transit Timetable
narrative.overview:
The design system translates Taiwanese visual culture — deep Taiwan Cultural Navy (#14365D), Temple Vermilion (#B8232A), warm gold contour ink (#E2BE7E), Sun Moon Lake Teal (#135D7D), Jiufen Lantern Terracotta (#9E4414), and cool Harbor Mist canvas (#DCE5F0) — into an ISO control-description travel guide and transit pocket timetable. Deep navy & vermilion anchor the bookend masthead and footer, while regional day-zone accents organize the 8-day schedule and the main reading column remains crisp #FFFFFF for outdoor legibility on mobile phones.

Instead of rounded card stacks, duplicate text boxes, or cluttered multi-button rows beside thumbnails, schedules pair stacked two-line left-gutter hours (.time-start / .time-end over #F3F6FA) with zone-colored day headers, a unified full-width .place-bar below each row (iconless .zh-chip / .sub-chip popup trigger + 44x44px Lake-tinted .map-icon-btn), semantic condition icons, Taiwanese landmark thumbnails (13 Gouache & Fine Ink + 8 interim Wikimedia photos), and an illustrated Taiwanese shopping catalog (ฝากผู้ใหญ่ / แจกเพื่อน / ซื้อกินเอง / ของใช้ & แฟชั่น).
keyCharacteristics: Deep Taiwan Navy masthead & bookend footer paired with Temple Vermilion accents (#B8232A), Harbor Mist canvas (#DCE5F0), and pure #FFFFFF reading cards.
Regional day-zone coding across the single-row [ทุกวัน] + (D0)–(D7) rail and day headers (#14365D Taipei/Departure, #135D7D Sun Moon Lake, #B8232A Old Taipei, #9E4414 Jiufen/Shifen Coast).
Stacked .time-start / .time-end tabular time gutter (#F3F6FA wash) eliminating mobile range overlap.

Unified .place-bar utility pattern: 44px iconless Navy-tinted Traditional Chinese chip (.zh-chip / .sub-chip) opening #driver-dialog ("ชื่อสถานที่ภาษาจีน") + 44x44px Lake-tinted icon-only Google Maps pin with zero redundant standalone Driver buttons.
Sharp 0px architectural keylines across tables, shopping cards, and buttons (50% circles solely for D0–D7 control markers).

Evolving unified visual system pairing 26 cohesive Taiwanese Gouache & Fine Ink illustrations (13 landmark 640x360 WebPs + 13 culinary/shopping 480x360 WebPs) plus 8 interim Wikimedia landmark photos pending the 19:10 completion wave.

rules.name: The Daylight Column Rule
rules.body: Topographic contour ornament frames the deep Taiwan Navy masthead and bookend footer; inside the reading column, tables and cards stay pure Paper White (#FFFFFF) or pale #F3F6FA / regional soft tints with >=4.5:1 text contrast.

rules.name: The Regional Accent Rule
rules.body: Each trip day carries one restrained zone accent across its rail node, day header top border, day code pill, and stacked .time-start numeral (#135D7D Lake, #B8232A Old Taipei, #9E4414 Coast, #14365D City), leaving Safety Amber and Transit Badges uncontested.

rules.name: The Zero-Kicker Rule
rules.body: Headings (h1, h2, h3) always come first with zero eyebrow labels above them; badges and meta tags sit inline or below.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Schedule tables, shopping cards, and buttons carry zero drop shadow at rest.

dos: Do keep body copy >=16px, interactive controls >=44px, and text contrast >=4.5:1 outdoors.
Do pair semantic inline SVGs with each condition or action (never repeat unrelated icons or Unicode emoji).
Do embed provenance sidecars (.webp.json) on every raster asset and use native <dialog closedby="any">.
donts: Don't place kickers or metadata pills above h1, h2, or h3 headings.
Don't duplicate place titles or Chinese strings into redundant boxes below descriptions.
Don't publish private info (ages, personal health/dietary notes, booking refs, budgets, cut lists, [ต้องเช็ก], or planner To-dos).
